english.title: Fail to comply with duty under s.790H to notify changes in PSC information
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowing that you were a registrable

(A)_[person]_
(B)_[relevant legal entity]_

in relation to a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), when there had been a change in your required particulars which you knew to be the case but had not informed the company of, or given the company all of the information that the company would need to include in a notice of the change under section 790LD(1) or 790LE(1) of the Companies Act 2006, failed, without reasonable excuse to inform the company of the change and give the company the information it would need to include in such a notice of change
english.legislation: Contrary to section 790H of, and paragraph 14 of Schedule 1B to, the Companies Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
